title: SAEVerbalizer: Generating Explanations for Sparse Autoencoder Features via Representation Verbalization
abstract: arXiv:2608.13538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are proposed to extract numerous features from large language model (LLM) representations, yet explaining these features still relies primarily on external observation. This reliance leads to superficial explanations inferred from observed model behavior and computational inefficiency from collecting such behavioral evidence at scale. We introduce SAEVerbalizer, a framework that injects SAE decoder directions into an LLM's representations and fine-tunes the LLM's downstream layers to generate natural-language explanations of the injected features. Once trained, the resulting verbalizer explains SAE features directly from decoder directions, addressing both limitations. translated_title: SAEVerbalizer：通过表征言语化生成稀疏自编码器特征的解释
translated_abstract: 摘要：稀疏自编码器（SAEs）被提出用于从大型语言模型（LLM）表征中提取大量特征，但解释这些特征仍主要依赖外部观察。这种依赖导致了从观察到的模型行为中推断出的肤浅解释，以及在大规模收集此类行为证据时的计算低效。我们引入了SAEVerbalizer，这是一个将SAE解码器方向注入LLM表征并微调LLM下游层以生成所注入特征的自然语言解释的框架。训练完成后，得到的言语化器直接从解码器方向解释SAE特征，解决了上述两个局限。我们的实验表明，学习到的言语化能力能泛化到未见特征，可迁移到独立训练的SAE字典之间，并且通过轻量级适配器，能扩展到来自不同LLM的SAE特征。
tldr: 本文提出SAEVerbalizer，通过将SAE解码器方向注入LLM表征并微调下游层，直接从解码器方向生成特征解释，克服了外部观察的依赖，并具备跨特征、跨字典和跨模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SAEVerbalizer, which injects SAE decoder directions into LLM representations and fine-tunes downstream layers to directly generate feature explanations, overcoming reliance on external observation while generalizing across features, dictionaries, and models.
